summary: Frontend-only testing of static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS landing page at /landing/index.html. Executed desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) UI tests using Playwright with prefers-reduced-motion=reduce to bypass Lenis smooth-scroll hijacking. All required sections, CTAs, data-testids, reveal animations, counters, nav anchor scrolling, hamburger menu, and responsive behavior verified working. No console errors. No functional bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Only harmless network failure observed: Cloudflare RUM beacon (cdn-cgi/rum) ERR_ABORTED - injected by preview host, not app code; safe to ignore.
All interactive elements correctly expose data-testid attributes (nav-cta-button, hero-primary-cta, hero-secondary-cta, cta-primary, cta-secondary, roi-cta).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Page uses Lenis smooth-scroll which hijacks window.scrollTo. To programmatically scroll during Playwright tests, either (a) click in-page nav anchor links which use lenis.scrollTo, or (b) call page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') which disables Lenis and makes all reveal-on-scroll content statically visible. Ids for anchor testing: #process, #goals, #techniques, #roi, #contact. Mobile toggle id: #nav-toggle.

test_results_detail.hero_section: PASS - eyebrow pill, H1 'Is your business in the spotlight?', subtitle, both CTAs, funnel (Reach/Engaged/Leads/Qualified) all visible
test_results_detail.nav_smooth_scroll: PASS - clicking Process nav link scrolls to y=2506
test_results_detail.reveal_animations: PASS - 36 reveal-gated elements, 0 stuck at opacity 0 after scroll
test_results_detail.mobile_hamburger: PASS - #nav-toggle visible, opens/closes nav (display:flex, height 71px when open)
test_results_detail.network_failures: Only Cloudflare RUM beacon (harmless CDN injected by preview host)
